text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, straighten your back.
Chin down... Okay, let's measure your height.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Forgive the sudden request.
I wanted to ensure accurate information was recorded for the application documents.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Don't mind me. Alright, all done.
171 cm... Oh, you've grown since last time.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
I suppose you're still in your growth phase.
I'll forward the results over to you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
With this—

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
? What's wrong?
Is there something bothering you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, no. Just thinking it's such a nostalgic scent.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (Back then, from my hospital bed, I was trying to formulate a single equation.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (The winning formula to surpass "you".)

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah... All right!
Let's pick up the pace even more, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text:
Aweeesome...! Me too, me too!!
I'm gonna catch up to you, Sis!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (How long was I truly able to lead by example as an older sister, I wonder?)

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Teacher. Next, please lend me "Introduction to Kinesiology."
I want to get even faster.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Why not try resting instead of overthinking it?
You want your injury to heal quickly, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No. Right now is precisely when you ought to think deeply.

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"If I look back at the root of it, it's because I was about to lose.
I panicked... and got injured."

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...That's why we need a "Formula for Victory."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (So I never lose again.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much for your cooperation.
Now, if you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't mention it. Supporting our students
is the duty of the academy staff, after all.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on your debut. Give it your all from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Coming out of the nurse's office,
Biwa Hayahide calls out to me with a refreshed look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—From today on, I will finally be taking on
the Twinkle Series together with her.”

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Now that the Make Debut date is set,
our course of action is clear.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Put in the training, map out the path to victory, and enter the race with an ironclad strategy. A completely natural conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And so, shall we start by timing my runs? So you can get a fresh grasp of where I stand right now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the blink of an eye, Biwa Hayahide
dashed off to the far side of the track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to measure times every furlong... every 200m.
The time displayed on the stopwatch is—

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's quite an impressive lap time.
As expected of Narita Brian's sister.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, don't look so surprised. Why not?
I came to check out a candidate for 'the strongest,' after all."

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer B
text_block_list.text: Right, right! She showed us some incredible running in the mock race the other day, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Before I knew it, my fellow Trainers from my class
had gathered around me.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
As a colleague, I'll be keeping a close eye on you!
Including how your training sessions go!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer C
text_block_list.text:
It was quite a surprise, though.
Who would've thought the older sister would debut before her little sister—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me. I'm glad you're all having fun, but would you mind letting me speak with him as well?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me. I'm glad you're all having fun, but would you mind letting me speak with her as well?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Good grief. You seem to be quite the popular one.
choice_data_list: It's not me, you're the one who's popular.
It's not me, you're the popular one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I shared the reputation regarding Biwa Hayahide
that I heard from a fellow trainer with her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. A candidate for one of the strongest, huh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I appreciate the praise,
but I shouldn't take it at face value.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The first reason is that their attention turned to me
simply because I was Narita Brian's older sister.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The second reason is that I am still only "above average."
That simply won't do at all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: For what I am challenging is "the strongest" itself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she spoke, behind her glasses, it felt as though
her eyes were fixed entirely on a single point.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Beyond my formula, on the other side of that equal sign...
does victory truly exist?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh... haha! That's right.
You were always that kind of person, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I look forward to working with you.
Let us complete the winning formula together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the days of walking side by side
with Biwa Hayahide began.
